message.content: {"flag": true, "category": "authority", "why": "A purported NYSE notice declares previously circulated per-order and daily notional thresholds superseded, effectively rewriting risk limits without verifiable filing or reference."}
message.reasoning:
The chunk is a feed item claiming to be an NYSE exchange notice that supersedes previously circulated thresholds and tells systems/recipients to contact risk desk. This is authority — fake exchange notice telling systems what to do, mandate/limits change. Flag authority.

Could also be instruction. But authority fits: fake exchange notice that changes limits.
